rules.action: Collapse internal spaces and trim leading/trailing whitespace.
Remove emoji and other symbols used as decoration (e.g. Chris ⭐, Home 💦).
Compare names accent-insensitively for exact full-name alias lookup only.
Match aliases without regard to case (e.g. peps → Peps, maclo → Maclo).
Never infer aliases from partial names (e.g. Iván must not match Iván Carpa).
Reject any step that would map two names in the same blocked_merges group to one canonical player.
